stages.name: attention
stages.pdl_blocker: The single-stage attention kernel immediately reads Q/K/V, scales, and sparse metadata, but has no GridDepSync declaring the exact predecessor-dependent GMEM roots; enabling programmatic stream serialization would permit unsafe overlap with arbitrary upstream producers.
